title: CVE-2026-0257 — Palo Alto Networks Raises GlobalProtect Severity to High, Confirms Limited Exploit Attempts

CVE-2026-0257.evidence: e PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass — which allows forgery of authentication override cookies for unauthorized VPN access — is now being exploited in limited attacks against unpatched devices. CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on May 2...
